questions.explanation: Both the exit and inside route changed, so update the handoff and protect the slot.

questions.prompt: Why should a behind-net call include an exit side and a threat name?
questions.explanation: The puck carrier can emerge on either side while the slot threat remains separate. Naming both tells teammates which relationship to exchange and which lane to protect.

questions.prompt: Gold 1 leaves the slot to pressure the puck. What should YOU weigh?

options.text: An inside connection if F1 can reach it, or hold high if Gold 2 covers

questions.prompt: How does a high outlet help a low cycle?
